name: KustoExplorerScene
description: High-fidelity Kusto Explorer desktop query surface with mockable connection tree, KQL editor, result grid, and timed highlights.

connections.description: Mock connection tree rows. Do not pass real tenant, cluster, database, or table names.

tabs.description: Open query tabs using mock workspace names.

address.description: Mock cluster/database locator shown above the editor.

queryLines.description: KQL lines to render in the editor. Use mock cluster/db/table names.

highlightLines.description: 1-based line numbers to highlight over time.

requestId.description: Mock request id shown in the status bar.

visualBeats.description: Motion-beat metadata for validation and review. The component animates chrome, tree rows, query lines, active-line focus, results, runner, and callout over time.

callout.description: Optional glass callout layered over the Kusto surface.

qualityNotes: Never use screenshots of real Kusto data inside this component; use mock props only.
Use this component when a scene needs a credible Kusto Explorer query or result-grid surface.
Keep query lines short enough to fit at 1920px; split complex queries across scenes.
